facts.text: Southern Utah University is the only institution in the nation designated as the University of the Parks.

sources.title: SUU is the University of the Parks
sources.quote: SUU is the only designated University of the Parks in the U.S. due to its unique location, academics, recreational opportunities and outdoor career prep.
sources.closest: is the university of the parks suu is the only designated university of the parks in the u.s. because of its unique combination of location, innovative academic programs, amazing recreational opportunities and outdoor career

facts.text: Southern Utah University offers an optional three-year degree track that allows students to complete eight semesters across three calendar years.

sources.title: Episode 52 - SUU's New Three-Year Degree Option
sources.quote: A three-year degree is simply doing eight semesters in three years instead of four.
